title: About Cardity
subtitle: Cardity Core is the protocol compiler layer for agent-generated systems

about2.title: About Cardity Core
about2.subtitle: A deterministic protocol layer between natural-language intent and agent-built software.

whatIs.title: What is Cardity
items: A public protocol compiler API that turns Cardity source into ABI, protocol JSON, and Agent OS manifests.
A shared contract for LLM agents, code-generation agents, and runtimes such as pmtsoul-agent.
A way to make one-sentence system generation less ambiguous before code is written.

capabilities.title: Core Capabilities
items: Compile protocol source into stable machine-readable artifacts.
Expose the same protocol layer through HTTPS API, MCP endpoint, CLI wrapper, or SDK.
Describe entities, actions, permissions, views, workflows, and audit requirements.
Help agents generate systems with clearer routes, data models, tools, and tests.

workflow.title: Workflow
items: Intent: user describes the system they want in natural language.
Protocol: an LLM converts intent into Cardity protocol source.
Compile: Cardity Core validates and emits ABI, protocol JSON, and Agent OS manifest.
Generate: pmtsoul-agent or another agent builds the system from the manifest.
Verify: generated code is checked against the protocol contract.

utxoDesign.title: Why a Protocol Layer
items: Prompts are flexible but hard to verify; protocols are explicit and diffable.
Agents need stable contracts before they can safely create tools, pages, and workflows.
A protocol layer lets multiple agents share the same system semantics.

indexerSpec.title: Artifact Contract
items: abi: callable actions, parameters, return structures
protocol_json: entities, actions, policies, workflows, views
agent_os_manifest: task graph, tool mapping, route/page hints, permissions
diagnostics: structured feedback for LLM repair loops

toolchain.title: Integration Surfaces
items: Public API: https://api.cardity.org
Remote MCP endpoint: https://api.cardity.org/mcp
CLI wrapper: local and CI usage
SDK: embedded product workflows

useCases.title: Example Use Cases
items: Generate a CRM, support desk, booking system, or internal workflow app from a short intent.
Give pmtsoul-agent a protocol manifest before asking it to write a full system.
Publish reusable protocol packages that any agent can call.

securityOps.title: Operations
items: Version ABI changes and make breaking changes explicit.
Keep the public API stateless; callers own business context and secrets.
Use diagnostics as the repair loop between Cardity Core and the LLM.
